name: Celtic Heroes
detailed_description:
Step into the legendary world of Dal Riata, where heroes rise, clans wage war, and mythical creatures roam the lands. Celtic Heroes is a free-to-play 3D MMORPG inspired by Celtic mythology, offering deep quest-driven gameplay, dynamic boss battles, and a thriving player-driven economy. Choose your class, forge your destiny, and relive the nostalgia of a decade-old adventure-filled world.

Key Features

A Free-to-Play MMORPG Without Restrictions

Earn gear, potions, and currency through gameplay. No paywalls, no locked content—just a fair and rewarding experience.

Epic Boss Battles & High-Stakes Combat

Face off against Celtic warlords, dragons, and mythical beasts. Take on world bosses, and PvP battles, either solo or with your clan. Victory brings valuable rewards and legendary loot.

Seasonal Events & Exclusive Rewards

Participate in limited-time events to earn unique armor, rare charms, and powerful weapons. Engage in community challenges and leave your mark on the world of Dal Riata.

Clan System – Build Your Legacy

Join a clan and gain access to a shared clan bank, where boss loot can be stored and distributed. 

A True Open Economy – Trade Without Limits

All gear and items are tradeable—nothing is bound to your character. Buy, sell, and exchange items via the Auction House and direct trading, shaping the in-game economy as you see fit.

Pets & Mounts with Unique Abilities

Summon combat pets to assist you in battle or ride powerful mounts to traverse the world faster.

Professions – Fishing, Cooking & Crafting

Take a break from combat and master the arts of fishing, cooking, and crafting. Catch rare fish, prepare meals with powerful buffs, and sell your goods for profit.

A Living, Expansive World

Explore forests and ancient ruins, complete story-driven quests, and customize your hero with a variety of armor sets, weapons, and abilities.

 

A CLASSIC MMORPG EXPERIENCE – EXPLORE, TRADE, BATTLE, AND BUILD YOUR LEGACY

Join thousands of players and forge your path in this evolving fantasy world.

Add to your wishlist and start your adventure today.

short_description: Are you looking for that classic MMORPG vibe? Whether you're a minmaxer strategizing every detail for maximum efficiency, a savvy fashion collector in search of the most stunning outfits, or even someone who enjoys the journey of casual leveling, Celtic Heroes opens its gates to you!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 capable
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: High Sierra 10.13+
  • Processor: Apple Silicon, x64 architecture with SSE2
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal capable Intel and AMD GPUs
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04, Ubuntu 18.04, and CentOS 7
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+, Vulkan capable
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
